note: Structural DOM finders shared by measure_sections.mjs and parity/parity.mjs. Each expression runs in the page and returns an array of elements whose union box is the section. Keyed on layout structure, never on visible copy.

finders.hero.intro: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('main section h1'); if (!h) { const m = document.querySelector('main main section h1'); return m ? [m.closest('section')] : []; } const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('main section > button')].find(b => b.className.includes('aspect-[4/5]')); return [h.parentElement, btn].filter(Boolean); })()
finders.portfolio.work-index: (() => { const m = document.querySelector('section[aria-labelledby]'); if (m) return [m.parentElement]; const c = document.querySelector('main section div[class*="!inset-0"]'); return c ? [c] : []; })()
finders.about.profile-header: (() => { const d = document.querySelector('div[class*="lg:top-[27%]"][class*="lg:w-[21%]"]'); if (d) return [d]; const a = document.querySelector('main main article'); if (!a) return []; return [...a.children].slice(0,2); })()
finders.about.media-stage: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('main main article'); if (a) return []; const c = document.querySelector('main section div[class*="!inset-0"]'); return c ? [c] : []; })()
finders.about.discipline-list: (() => { const d = document.querySelector('div[class*="bottom-[5%]"][class*="right-[3.1%]"]'); if (d) return [d]; const a = document.querySelector('main main article'); return a && a.children[2] ? [a.children[2]] : []; })()
finders.project.header: (() => { const d = document.querySelector('div[class*="md:top-[27%]"][class*="md:w-[20.5%]"]'); if (d) return [d]; const h = document.querySelector('main main article > header'); return h ? [h] : []; })()
finders.project.media-stage: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('main main article > div.space-y-3'); if (s) return [s]; const c = document.querySelector('main section div[class*="!inset-0"]'); return c ? [c] : []; })()
finders.project.meta: (() => { const d = document.querySelector('div[class*="bottom-[26%]"][class*="right-[3.8%]"]'); if (d && d.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0) return [d]; const g = document.querySelector('main main article > div[class*="grid-cols-2"]'); return g ? [g] : []; })()
